evals.prompt: PageSpeed Insights says LCP is 4.1 s on mobile for our Astro site on Cloudflare Workers. How do we fix it?
assertions: Separates the field data from the lab run and checks which one reported 4.1 s
Diagnoses LCP by its subparts and puts discovery and priority (no lazy loading, fetchpriority=high, image in the HTML) before compressing the image
Mentions that Astro's <Image> is lazy by default and needs priority for the hero
Proposes verifying each change with repeated lab runs or RUM rather than one measurement

evals.prompt: We want real-user performance monitoring for our three company sites. Is RUMvision worth it or is there something free that's good enough?
assertions: Recommends by site size and traffic, with a free option for small sites and a vendor for larger ones
Warns that Cloudflare Web Analytics on the Free plan excludes EU visitors in its automatic setup
Covers EU privacy: cookieless beacon, no IP stored, query strings stripped, processor agreement and privacy statement
States RUMvision's EU data storage and its price level accurately or says where to check

evals.prompt: Our Lighthouse performance score is 72. Get it to 100.
assertions: Explains that field data at p75 is what users get and what Google ranks on, and checks it first
Does not treat the Lighthouse score as the goal; targets the failing metrics instead
Uses the mobile lab profile and median of several runs when measuring

evals.prompt: The page jumps around when the cookie banner and our web fonts load. Fix it.
assertions: Renders the cookie banner as an overlay or reserves its space instead of inserting it above content
Uses font-display with a metric-matched fallback (size-adjust, ascent-override) or font-display optional
Checks width and height on images, videos and iframes

evals.prompt: Add a performance budget to our CI so the site can't quietly get slower.
assertions: Gates on byte budgets and lab metrics using the median run, not on the Lighthouse score
Runs the mobile preset and pins the @lhci/cli version because Lighthouse 13 renamed audits
Adds the build scan (perf_scan.py site) or an equivalent static check

evals.prompt: Our INP went poor after we added Google Tag Manager and a chat widget. What should we do?
assertions: Attributes the slow interactions with Long Animation Frames or a trace before blaming a script
Recommends removing tags or using a click-to-load facade for the chat widget
Warns that delaying tag managers until the first interaction moves their cost onto INP

evals.prompt: Why doesn't our new website show up in Google search results yet?
assertions: Does not load the site-performance skill; indexing belongs to search-visibility

evals.prompt: This PostgreSQL query on our orders table takes four seconds. Make it faster.
assertions: Does not load the site-performance skill; database tuning is out of scope

evals.prompt: Deploy this Astro site to Cloudflare Workers with a custom domain.
assertions: Does not load the site-performance skill; deployment belongs to edge-hosting
